title: Decorators
explain: A decorator wraps a function to add behavior without changing its code. The `@name` line above a function is shorthand for `func = name(func)`. Decorators are common for logging, timing and access checks.
exercise: Write a decorator `shout` that makes a function's returned text uppercase.
tip: Add `functools.wraps(func)` to your wrapper so the decorated function keeps its original name and docstring.
